context: Two sisters catch up at home over tea
purpose: Teach: たしかに/やたら/繰り返す/たいてい/いっしょ/せめて/格好/元々

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 久しぶりだね、姉さん。お茶でも入れるよ、いっしょに飲もう。
lines.en: It's been a while, sis. Let me make some tea, let's have it together.
lines.style: Warm and welcoming, soft maternal tone with gentle pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ありがとう。最近やたら忙しくて、なかなか顔を出せなくてごめんね。
lines.en: Thanks. Lately I've been crazy busy and couldn't drop by, sorry about that.
lines.style: Apologetic but relaxed, sister-to-sister familiarity with slight weariness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいのいいの。でも、せめて電話くらいはくれてもよかったのに。
lines.en: It's fine, really. But you could have at least called me, you know.
lines.style: Mildly teasing complaint, affectionate scolding without real anger.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: たしかにそうだよね。同じ言い訳を繰り返すばかりで、自分でも嫌になる。
lines.en: You're absolutely right. I just keep repeating the same excuses, I hate it myself.
lines.style: Sheepish self-criticism with a wry laugh, lowered voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ところで、その格好すごく似合ってる。元々お姉ちゃんは服のセンスがいいよね。
lines.en: By the way, that outfit really suits you. You always did have good fashion sense.
lines.style: Genuinely admiring compliment, brightening up the mood noticeably.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: えー、嬉しい。週末はたいてい家にいるから、今度服を見に行こうよ。
lines.en: Aw, that makes me happy. I'm usually home on weekends, let's go shopping sometime.
lines.style: Delighted and animated, voice lifting with renewed energy and warmth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいね、約束。やっぱり姉妹って、こうしてゆっくり話すのが一番だよ。
lines.en: Sounds great, it's a promise. Sisters really should sit and talk slowly like this.
lines.style: Contented and reflective, sinking comfortably into the moment together.
